title: Which of net1's beliefs the learned net2 uses: r18e05 with one LCF at a time from the truth
description: r18e05 passed its gate and its test on net1 v6 (exp-net2-test-r18e05-168). This runs it unchanged next to eight variants in which one of net1's seven LCFs, or all of them, comes from the guest's live truth (all probability on the true value's bin; release model-net2-v6-patch), against net1 v6's fixed rule and BBRv3, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, campaign seed 11 as at the gate. Each variant minus r18e05 is what that LCF's estimation error costs this net2, or gains it (H2, and H5's tracing of a fault to one LCF). The students never saw a one-bin belief in training, so a patch also moves their inputs out of distribution; a loss can come from that rather than from the truth.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/p" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$N" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-r18e05-*.onnx "$IN"/p/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT" rule-v6
